import cv2,json,sys; out=[]
for p in json.loads(sys.argv[1]):
 c=cv2.VideoCapture(p); n=0; declared=int(c.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT)); fps=c.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
 while True:
  ok,f=c.read()
  if not ok:break
  n+=1
 c.release(); out.append(dict(path=p,decoded_frames=n,declared_frames=declared,fps=fps,ok=n>0 and n==declared))
print(json.dumps(out)); sys.exit(0)
